title: ZoomIt text extraction shortcut added in 0.99 silently breaks international keyboard usage
author: teasmade
summary: ZoomIt's default text-extraction chord collides with AltGr character entry on international layouts and is enabled without a dashboard conflict warning.
next_action: Approve a safer default and AltGr-aware conflict reporting design.

confidence.rationale: The exact chord collision is deterministic, acknowledged by the existing settings warning, and introduced with the new default.

judgment.rationale: ZoomIt's newly enabled text-extraction shortcut uses Ctrl+Alt+6, which is the AltGr sequence for entering circumflex characters on UK Extended and other international layouts. The settings warning confirms the collision, but the global shortcut-conflict surface does not report it.
evidence: Pressing AltGr/Ctrl+Alt+6 launches ZoomIt text extraction instead of entering a circumflex composition.
The issue started when the ZoomIt shortcut was added in PowerToys 0.99.
ZoomIt settings already warn about possible AltGr interference.
PowerToys' Shortcut conflicts page does not expose the conflict.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a safer default and AltGr-aware conflict reporting design.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt covers the scoped PowerToys-owned path identified by this lightweight judgment.

proposed_fixes.title: Avoid and report AltGr-conflicting ZoomIt defaults
proposed_fixes.root_cause: ZoomIt registers Ctrl+Alt+6 globally even though Windows international layouts use the equivalent AltGr+6 chord for dead-key text composition.
plan: Choose a default text-extraction chord that does not overlap common AltGr text-entry sequences, with migration that preserves explicit user choices.
Teach the shared shortcut-conflict model that AltGr can emit Ctrl+Alt and flag those collisions in the dashboard.
Keep the local editor warning and add clear attribution when ZoomIt owns a conflicting chord.
verification: On UK Extended and another AltGr layout, enter circumflex-accented characters without launching ZoomIt.
Verify the Shortcut conflicts page reports an intentionally configured AltGr-equivalent ZoomIt chord.

confidence.rationale: The exact chord collision is deterministic, acknowledged by the existing settings warning, and introduced with the new default.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt's default text-extraction chord collides with AltGr character entry on international layouts and is enabled without a dashboard conflict warning.
known_information: The reported layout is United Kingdom Extended.
AltGr is represented as Ctrl+Alt for the affected character sequence.
The collision prevents normal text entry and unexpectedly opens a full-screen ZoomIt mode.
The per-setting editor knows the chord can interfere with AltGr.
inferences: The default shortcut and global conflict detector were chosen without treating AltGr-equivalent chords as reserved text-input sequences.
issue_context.analysis: The root cause is direct and user-visible. A fix should avoid enabling a conflicting default for existing international-layout users and make AltGr equivalence visible wherever shortcut conflicts are summarized.

Found no linked implementation or existing fix attempt.
